problems.title: A logarithm sign chart
problems.question: Solve x(x-2)log₀.₅(x²)+2log₂(x⁸)≤0.
problems.idea: Use log₂|x| to express both logarithms.
steps: The inequality becomes -2(x-4)(x+2)log₂|x|≤0.
Thus (x-4)(x+2)log₂|x|≥0.
The sign changes at -2,-1,0,1,4; 0 is excluded. A sign chart gives the intervals in the answer.

problems.title: Two indefinite integrals
problems.question: Compute (a) ∫(3^x-4^x)²/12^x dx; (b) ∫x/(x²-4x+3) dx.
problems.idea: Expand the first integrand and split the second into partial fractions.
steps: (a) The integrand is (3/4)^x-2+(4/3)^x. Integrate each term separately.
Integrating gives the two logarithms, valid on intervals avoiding 1 and 3.

problems.title: Largest cylinder inside a cone
problems.question: A cone has base radius 4,height 8. Find the greatest volume of an inscribed coaxial cylinder.
problems.idea: Similarity relates cylinder radius and height.
steps: Differentiate to get V′=16π(1-h/8)(1-3h/8).
The interior maximum occurs at h=8/3,r=8/3; the endpoint volumes are zero.
Its volume is π(64/9)(8/3)=512π/27.

problems.title: Distances to an ellipse’s foci
problems.question: On x²/16+y²/4=1, find points three times as far from the left focus as from the right focus.
steps: The ratio 3:1 gives distances 6 and 2.
Substitute into the ellipse to get y²=8/3.
problems.note: This follows the scanned wording, which says farther from the left focus. Reversing left and right would negate x.

problems.title: Two tangents from a given point
problems.question: Find the tangents to x²/9-y²/8=1 through A=(2,1).
formulas: Tangency condition for this hyperbola: k²=9m²-8.
steps: Substitution gives (1-2m)²=9m²-8, or 5m²+4m-9=0.
The slopes are m=1 and m=-9/5.
Both yield real finite tangency points; substituting each line gives a repeated quadratic root.

problems.title: Increasing on the whole real axis
problems.question: For which a is f(x)=2e^x-ae^(-x)+(1+2a)x-3 increasing on ℝ?
problems.idea: Check its derivative near negative infinity and then everywhere.
steps: If a<0, the term ae^(-x) tends to -∞ as x→-∞, so the function cannot be increasing everywhere.
If a≥0, every exponential contribution is nonnegative and 1+2a>0.
Thus f′ is strictly positive for every real x.

problems.title: The radical terms cancel on their domain
problems.question: Minimize |√(4-x²)-6|+√(4-x²)+x⁴-4x³.
problems.idea: On [-2,2] the square root is at most 2.
steps: The function simplifies to 6+x⁴-4x³ on [-2,2].
Its derivative is 4x²(x-3)≤0 throughout the domain, so it decreases to the right endpoint.
At x=2 the value is 6+16-32=-10.

problems.title: Distance to a plane through three points
problems.question: A=(-1,1,2),B=(1,-1,1),C=(1,1,-2),D=(2,2,3). Find the distance from D to plane ABC.
problems.idea: Find a normal using a cross product.
steps: The plane is 4x+3y+2z-3=0, as substitution of A confirms.

problems.title: Analyze a rational cubic
problems.question: Study and sketch y=x³/[2(x+1)²].
problems.idea: Find its derivatives and divide to reveal the slant asymptote.
steps: Domain: x≠-1. The only intercept is (0,0). Both one-sided limits at -1 are -∞, giving vertical asymptote x=-1; the slant asymptote is y=x/2-1.
The derivative is positive on (-∞,-3), negative on (-3,-1), and positive on (-1,∞) except for its isolated zero at 0. There is a local maximum (-3,-27/8).
The second derivative is negative for x<0, excluding -1, and positive for x>0. Thus (0,0) is a stationary inflection point.
The right branch increases from -∞ to ∞, so the overall range is ℝ.
problems.answer: Vertical asymptote x=-1; slant asymptote y=x/2-1; local maximum (-3,-27/8), stationary inflection (0,0).

problems.title: Shortest parabola-to-line distance
problems.question: Find the least distance from y=x²-8x+16 to y=-2x-1.
problems.idea: Use the point-to-line formula on a general parabola point.
steps: The expression inside the absolute value is positive for all x.
The square is least at x=3, where the parabola point is (3,1).
The minimum distance is 8/√5.
